disqualifier.note: Contextual-alias changes, additive range splits, and other semantic or lineage changes are independent comparison facts; the semantic-drift predicate composes them without storing an exclusive phase.

S.is membership of existing LiteralKit subdomains over one HohfeldPositionKind. Advantage overlaps both orbits (claim/privilege vs power/immunity); deontic vs potestative is a partition already modeled as literals, not stored parallel flags.

Independent frame-shape validators: distinct element labels vs presence of an actor slot. A frame can fail one and pass the other; hasDerivationKind is a third nonempty-set check on a different field.
S.is guards over different values: markdown Ol blocks vs ambiguous transition tokens (including/having). Match.when(isOrderedList) and the transition check never share a subject.
FileInfo.guards.Directory then File over one stat result. Combined-true is schema-impossible; the pair is a tagged-union membership walk, not stored parallel flags. Other kinds fall through to empty.

Independent coverage facts ANDed to keep a disposition: self-declared active lifecycle versus being named in another row's supersedes set. Mixed pairs are the point (active-but-retired is dropped; withdrawn-and-unretired is dropped). Leftover after the sameIdentifiedPatentReference.probes seed.
